decisions.reason: This full sports-floor system is outside the core trend-led interior direction and its results likely no longer justify the cost of keeping the option open.
A mobile arena system is a complex, low-volume option whose uncertainty has resolved unfavourably, so the firm abandons it.
Like B, this redundant mobile arena option has shown little value and is dropped to release resources.
As the flagship chevron parquet close to the established offer, its value is more certain and it aligns with the firm's style-oriented path, so it is kept.
This squash surface finish serves a very small niche outside the firm's core and its option value is unlikely to be realized, so it is dropped.
As a complement to the sports-floor options being dropped, this low-cost skirting no longer has a clear path to value and is likely abandoned.
